Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows. Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull the dumbbells up, and inhale as you lower them back down.

records.name: 胸部动态拉伸
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Swing your arms forward, crossing them in front of your chest.
Open your arms wide, stretching your chest as you do.
Repeat the swinging motion for the desired number of repetitions.
records.originalInstructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended at shoulder height. Swing your arms in a controlled, hugging motion across your chest and then open wide, repeating rhythmically to stretch and activate the chest.
records.breathing: Breathe naturally throughout the movement.

records.name: 椭圆机
steps: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Select desired resistance and incline.
Begin moving feet in a smooth, elliptical pattern.
Push and pull the handles with your arms in sync with your strides.
Maintain a steady cadence and upright posture.
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward or backward
Relying only on legs or arms
records.originalInstructions: Step onto the elliptical machine and grasp the moving handles. Begin moving feet in an elliptical motion, engaging both the lower and upper body by pushing and pulling the handles as you stride.
records.breathing: Maintain rhythmic, deep breathing throughout the workout.

records.name: 瑞士球仰卧起坐
steps: Sit on the exercise ball with feet flat on the floor.
Walk feet forward, rolling until the ball supports your lower back.
Cross arms over your chest or position hands behind your head.
Engage your core and sit up, lifting your upper body.
Lower back down under control to starting position.
commonMistakes: Ball not positioned under lower back
records.originalInstructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet forward until the ball is under your lower back. Cross your arms over your chest or place hands behind your head, then contract your abs to lift your torso, performing a sit-up. Lower yourself back down slowly and repeat.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 瑞士球脊柱拉伸
aliases: Stretching - Spinal Stretch On Exercise Ball
steps: Sit on the exercise ball with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling until your back is draped over the ball.
Let your arms extend overhead or rest beside you for support.
Relax into the stretch, allowing your spine to gently extend.
Hold for the desired duration, then carefully return to a seated position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on a stability ball and carefully roll down until your back is resting on the ball. Extend your arms overhead and allow your spine to gently arch over the ball, stretching the entire length of your back. Hold the stretch, breathing deeply.
records.breathing: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

records.name: EZ杠弯举
steps: Grip the EZ bar at angled sections, palms facing up.
Stand tall with arms fully extended and elbows anchored.
Curl the bar upward, contracting the biceps.
Pause and squeeze at the top.
Lower the bar down slowly.
records.originalInstructions: Stand upright holding an EZ bar with hands on the angled grips, arms fully extended. Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping elbows close to your torso. Squeeze the biceps at the top, then slowly lower to the starting position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift, inhale lowering the bar.

records.name: 曲杆仰卧臂屈伸
steps: Lie on bench, grip EZ bar with medium width.
Extend arms fully above chest.
Bend elbows, lowering bar toward forehead.
Keep upper arms stationary.
Extend to starting position, repeat.
commonMistakes: Lowering bar too far past head
records.originalInstructions: Lie on a flat bench holding the EZ bar with arms extended above your chest. Bend elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, upper arms stationary. Extend arms back up, focusing on triceps contraction, and repeat for desired reps.
records.breathing: Inhale lowering bar, exhale extending arms.

records.name: EZ杠反重力推举
aliases: overhead shoulder press with EZ bar
steps: Stand tall with your feet about hip- to shoulder-width apart and hold the EZ bar at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended above your shoulders.
Move your head slightly back as the bar passes your face, then bring your head through under the bar at the top.
Lower the bar under control back to shoulder height.
Repeat each rep from a stable standing position.
commonMistakes: Leaning back hard and turning it into an incline press
Pressing the bar out in front instead of overhead
Flaring the elbows too far out from the start
Lowering the bar too fast and bouncing at the shoulders
records.originalInstructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding the ez barbell with an overhand grip. Raise the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly bent and your palms facing forward. Press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale and brace at shoulder height, exhale as you press overhead, and inhale again as you lower the bar back down.

records.name: 脚踝绕环拉伸
steps: Sit or stand and lift one foot off the ground.
Point your toes and slowly rotate your ankle in circles.
Make several circles clockwise, then reverse to counterclockwise.
Repeat for the other ankle.
Maintain steady breathing and controlled motion.
records.originalInstructions: Sit or stand with one leg lifted and rotate your foot at the ankle in slow, controlled circles, first one direction and then the other. Focus on full range of motion to stretch and warm up lower leg muscles and joints.
records.breathing: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

records.name: 脚踝伸展
steps: Sit or stand with legs extended or positioned comfortably.
Point your toes downward to stretch the top of your feet and fronts of your ankles.
Flex your toes upward toward your shins to stretch the calves and back of the ankles.
Hold each position for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat the sequence for several reps.
commonMistakes: Overstretching or forcing range of motion
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended. Point and flex your toes to stretch the ankle and foot muscles. Hold the stretch for several seconds and repeat as needed.
formCues: Hold gentle tension, do not force
records.breathing: Breathe normally throughout, or exhale as you relax into each stretch.

records.name: 平凳绳索飞鸟
aliases: Cable Lying Fly, Flat Bench Cable Fly
steps: Set a flat bench between two cable pulleys and attach handles.
Lie back and grip each handle with arms extended.
With elbows slightly bent, bring handles together above your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Slowly return to the starting position with control.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on a flat bench positioned between two low cable pulleys. Grab the handles with arms extended and a slight bend in the elbows, then bring your hands together in a wide arc before returning to the start position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you bring hands together, inhale as you return.

records.name: 屈腿仰卧起坐拉伸
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross arms over chest or reach toward knees.
Contract abdominal muscles to sit up, curling your spine.
Reach for your knees at the top to enhance the stretch.
Lower back to starting position with control.
records.originalInstructions: Start lying on your back with knees bent. Flex your spine as you perform a sit-up, reaching toward your knees. Pause in the top position for a stretch before lowering back down.
records.breathing: Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 地面卷腹
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet hip-width apart.
Place hands lightly behind head or cross over chest.
Engage core and lift shoulders off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands behind your head or across your chest, engage your core, and curl your shoulders up toward your knees.
records.breathing: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 前臂平板支撑
steps: Lie face down, placing forearms on the ground and elbows under shoulders.
Lift your body off the floor, supporting weight on forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and glutes for stability.
Hold the position for the prescribed time, then lower to the ground.
records.originalInstructions: Start in a prone position with forearms and toes on the ground. Engage your core, keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, and hold the position for the desired amount of time without allowing hips to rise or sag.
records.breathing: Breathe slowly and steadily during the hold.

records.name: 站姿触脚尖拉伸
steps: Stand (or sit) with legs straight.
Bend slowly forward from the hips, keeping a flat back.
Reach towards or touch your toes with your hands.
Keep knees straight but not locked.
Hold stretch, then return to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Stand or sit with legs straight. Hinge at the hips and reach forward toward your toes, keeping your spine long. Hold at your end range, feeling a stretch in the back of your legs.
formCues: Keep head in line with spine
records.breathing: Exhale as you bend forward, inhale as you return upright.

records.name: 臀桥
steps: Start lying on back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart.
Arms rest at sides, palms down.
Push through heels, lifting hips toward ceiling.
Pause and squeeze glutes at top.
Lower hips back to floor.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart. Drive through your heels to lift hips off the ground, squeezing the glutes at the top, then lower back down with control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 悬垂举腿抬髋
steps: Hang from the bar with both hands and let your body settle into a dead hang.
Pull your ribs down and brace your midsection to stop excess swinging.
Bend your knees and lift them toward your chest by curling your hips upward.
Raise until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor or your knees reach hip height.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your torso steady.
Lower your legs with control until you return to a full hang.
commonMistakes: Swinging the body to start each rep
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Dropping the legs quickly on the way down
Only lifting the knees halfway with no hip curl
records.originalInstructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you. Engage your core and lift your legs up by flexing your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the ground. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you raise your knees and curl your hips up; inhale as you lower back to the hang.

records.name: 悬垂直腿举腿
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended.
Keep legs together and straight.
Engage core and lift legs up to parallel or higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower legs under control to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, keeping your body steady. Contract your core and raise your legs, keeping them straight, until they're parallel to the ground or higher. Lower your legs with control and repeat.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift legs, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 髋部绕环拉伸
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, hands on hips.
Lift one knee up in front of you.
Move your knee and thigh in a circular motion outward.
Reverse and perform circles inward after the set.
Switch legs and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Stand upright and place your hands on your hips. Lift one knee and move your leg in a controlled circular motion from the hip joint, reversing direction as needed; repeat with the other leg.
records.breathing: Inhale and exhale naturally during the stretch.

records.name: 髋伸展拉伸
steps: Lie face down with legs extended.
Place hands beneath shoulders, elbows bent.
Press palms into floor, lifting chest and gently extending hips.
Hold the stretch at a comfortable tension.
Slowly lower back down.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your stomach with legs outstretched and hands placed underneath your shoulders. Gently press up through your palms, extending the hips and lifting your torso without overextending the low back. Maintain a gentle stretch and hold.
records.breathing: Inhale while preparing, exhale as you press up into stretch.

records.name: 髋屈肌与股四头肌拉伸
aliases: Stretching - Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch
intermediate hip flexor and quad stretch
steps: Begin in a half-kneeling position, one knee down, one foot forward.
Keep torso upright with hands on hips or front knee.
Push hips forward slightly to increase the stretch.
Feel the stretch in the hip flexor and thigh of the back leg.
Hold for desired time, then switch legs.
commonMistakes: Letting front knee go past toes
records.originalInstructions: Start in a half-kneeling (lunge) position with one knee on the floor and the other foot planted in front. Gently shift hips forward while keeping torso upright, feeling the stretch in the front of the rear leg and thigh. Hold, then switch sides.
records.breathing: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

records.name: 上斜凳举腿抬髋
steps: Lie face up on an incline bench and grip the handles behind your head.
Extend your legs straight and keep them together.
Raise your legs towards your chest, lifting your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top, focusing on contracting your abs.
Lower your legs under control to the starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back on an incline bench and hold the handles or bench for stability. Keeping legs straight, lift them until your hips come off the bench, then lower slowly.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower legs.

records.name: 上斜俯卧撑
steps: Place hands shoulder-width apart on elevated surface.
Extend legs back with feet together, forming a straight line.
Lower chest toward the surface, elbows at 45 degrees.
Pause when chest is just above the surface.
Push back up to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface like a bench, stand with feet extended behind you and body straight. Lower your chest toward the surface, keeping elbows at a 45-degree angle, then press up to starting position.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push up.

records.name: 双椅间反向划船
steps: Set up a sturdy bar between two heavy chairs.
Lie underneath with your chest directly below the bar.
Grip the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Brace your body, keeping a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar, pause, then lower yourself slowly.
records.originalInstructions: Set up a sturdy bar or stick horizontally between two secure chairs. Lie on your back underneath the bar, grasp it with an overhand, shoulder-width grip, and keep your body straight from head to heels. Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower yourself back down with control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 吊带反向划船
steps: Set the straps to about chest height and stand facing the anchor point.
Grab the handles with an overhand grip and walk your feet forward until your body leans back in a straight line.
Brace your core and keep your heels planted with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly when your hands reach your ribs or chest.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight again.
commonMistakes: Hips sag or pike instead of staying straight
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Pulling with bent wrists and loose handles
Letting the body drop quickly on the way down
records.originalInstructions: Set up a suspension trainer or straps at chest height. Stand facing the anchor point and grab the handles with an overhand grip. Walk your feet forward, leaning back until your body is at an angle. Keep your body straight and engage your core. Pull your chest towards the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower yourself away from the handles, and exhale as you pull your chest toward them.

records.name: 十字转体拉伸
steps: Lie on your back with arms extended out to the sides.
Lift one leg straight up towards the ceiling.
Sweep the raised leg across your body to the opposite side.
Allow your foot to touch or lower towards the floor.
Hold the stretch, then switch legs.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with arms spread out in a 'T' position. Lift one leg straight up and sweep it across your body to the opposite side, letting it fall toward the floor while keeping your shoulders flat. Hold the position, feeling a stretch through your torso and hip.
records.breathing: Exhale as you move into the twist, inhale as you return to center.

records.name: 普拉提折刀式
steps: Lie on your back with arms at your sides and legs extended.
Engage your core and lift legs towards the ceiling.
Continue lifting hips off the mat, reaching feet upward.
Pause at the top with hips elevated.
Slowly roll back down vertebra by vertebra.
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back with arms by your sides and legs together. Lift your legs towards the ceiling and roll your hips off the mat, supporting your back lightly with your hands if needed, then lower with control.
records.breathing: Exhale while lifting up, inhale while lowering down.

records.name: 地面折刀收腹
steps: Lie flat with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Engage your core, lift arms and legs toward each other.
Reach hands toward feet, forming a 'V' at the top.
Pause briefly, squeezing at the top.
Lower back down slowly to starting position.
commonMistakes: Bending knees or elbows too much
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back with arms and legs extended. Simultaneously lift your arms, head, and legs, bringing your hands to meet your shins or feet at the top, then lower back down with control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 折刀分腿卷腹
steps: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Engage your core and simultaneously lift your torso and legs off the ground.
As you rise, spread your legs into a split while reaching your hands toward your feet.
Pause at the top, squeezing your abs.
Lower your legs and torso back to the ground with control, bringing feet together.
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and arms overhead. Simultaneously lift your torso and legs while spreading your feet apart (splitting legs) and reaching your hands towards your feet. Lower back to the starting position with control.
records.breathing: Exhale when crunching up, inhale when lowering down.

records.name: 跳绳
steps: Hold a handle in each hand with the rope behind your heels.
Stand tall with feet close together and elbows tucked by your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists and swing it up overhead.
Hop just high enough to clear the rope as it passes under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent.
Keep the rope moving in a smooth rhythm and repeat each jump.
commonMistakes: Swinging the arms in big circles instead of using the wrists
Jumping too high off the floor on each rep
Landing flat-footed or with stiff knees
Letting the hands drift wide away from the hips
records.originalInstructions: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet. Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again. Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Breathe steadily and naturally, exhaling softly every few jumps while keeping a relaxed rhythm.

records.name: 跳跃登阶
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or platform.
Place one foot firmly on top of the box.
Drive through the heel and explode upward, lifting your other knee high.
Land softly on the box with both feet.
Step or jump down with control and repeat.
commonMistakes: Not using full range of motion
records.originalInstructions: Stand in front of a box or platform. Step onto the box with one foot, then explosively jump up, driving through the working leg. Land softly and return to the starting position, alternating legs if desired.
formCues: Drive explosively through the lead leg
records.breathing: Exhale during the jump, inhale as you land and reset.

records.name: 开合跳（来源低冲击变式）
steps: Start with feet together and arms relaxed at your sides.
Jump feet out to shoulder-width as you raise arms overhead.
Briefly touch hands or keep arms straight above head.
Jump feet back together and arms down to sides.
Repeat at a brisk pace.
records.originalInstructions: Begin standing with feet together and arms at sides. Jump feet outward while raising arms overhead, then reverse to starting position in a single fluid motion.
records.breathing: Breathe evenly throughout the movement.

records.name: 壶铃硬拉
steps: Place kettlebell between your feet; stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips and bend knees, keeping back flat and chest up.
Grip the kettlebell handle with both hands.
Drive through your heels to stand up, fully extending hips and knees.
Lower the kettlebell to the floor under control by hinging at the hips.
records.originalInstructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, kettlebell between your feet. Hinge at the hips, bend knees and keep your back flat as you grip the kettlebell handle with both hands. Drive through your heels, extend hips and stand tall with the kettlebell, then reverse the movement to return to start.
records.breathing: Exhale as you stand up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 跪姿背部转体拉伸
steps: Kneel on the floor (all fours or lunge position).
Place one hand behind your head or neck.
Rotate elbow and upper body upward, opening chest.
Hold for a moment at top of rotation.
Return to start and repeat; switch sides.
records.originalInstructions: Begin in a quadruped or kneeling lunge position. Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso to open the chest, aiming elbow upward. Hold briefly and return, then repeat on the other side.
records.breathing: Exhale as you rotate, inhale returning to start.

records.name: 跪姿背阔肌拉伸
steps: Kneel and sit hips back on heels.
Reach both arms forward, palms on floor.
Push chest toward the ground.
Hold the stretch, focusing on the long side body.
Optionally shift hands to each side for more stretch.
records.originalInstructions: Kneel on the ground, sit your hips back towards your heels, and reach both arms straight out in front of you on the floor. Push your chest down and feel the stretch along each side of your back. Hold, then optionally move hands to each side to target one lat more intensely.
records.breathing: Inhale deeply as you reach forward, exhale as you sink deeper into the stretch.

records.name: 跪姿肱三头肌拉伸
steps: Kneel on the floor or mat.
Raise one arm overhead then bend the elbow so your hand touches your upper back.
Use your other hand to gently push on the bent elbow.
Hold the stretch.
Switch arms and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Kneel on the floor and reach one arm overhead, bending the elbow to let your hand touch your upper back. With the opposite hand, gently press on the bent elbow to increase the stretch.
records.breathing: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

records.name: 地雷杆180度转体
steps: Stand facing the free end of the barbell with your feet about shoulder-width apart, and hold the barbell sleeve with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly, brace your midsection, and keep your arms long but not locked.
Rotate your shoulders and hips together to lower the barbell toward one hip.
Drive through your feet and rotate across your body to sweep the barbell in an arc toward the opposite side.
Control the barbell as it changes direction, and continue rotating side to side with your chest facing the barbell.
Keep the movement smooth and balanced on both sides until the set is complete.
commonMistakes: Twisting only the arms while the torso stays still
Letting the lower back arch as the bar moves
Locking the knees and staying flat-footed
Jerking the bar instead of controlling the arc
records.originalInstructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with both hands in front of your chest. Bend your knees slightly and rotate your torso to the right, swinging the barbell down towards your right hip. As you reach the bottom of the movement, quickly reverse the motion and rotate your torso to the left, swinging the barbell up and across your body towards your left shoulder. Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions.
formCues: Move the bar in an arc
records.breathing: Inhale as the barbell moves to one side, and exhale as you rotate it across to the other side.

records.name: 举腿卷腹
steps: Lie on your back and extend your legs.
Place your hands by your sides or behind your head.
Simultaneously lift your legs and upper torso toward each other.
Squeeze at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs and upper body back down under control.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides and legs extended. Raise your legs and torso together, crunching your upper body forward as you lift your legs off the floor, then slowly return to starting position.
formCues: Keep lower back pressed to floor
records.breathing: Exhale during the crunch, inhale as you return.

records.name: 举腿抬髋
aliases: lying leg raise with hip lift
steps: Lie flat with arms at your sides and legs straight.
Raise your legs up together towards the ceiling.
At the top of the movement, press your legs up by lifting your hips off the ground.
Pause, squeezing your abs.
Lower your hips and legs back to the starting position slowly.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides. Raise your legs until they are perpendicular to the floor, then lift your hips off the ground by contracting your lower abs. Lower back slowly with control.
records.breathing: Exhale during hip lift, inhale during the descent.

records.name: 器械背伸展
steps: Adjust the machine so the back pad sits comfortably against your upper back and your feet are secured on the platform.
Sit tall against the pad and grip the handles or side bars.
Brace your core and lean your torso forward under control through the machine's range.
Stop at the bottom when you feel a comfortable stretch and keep your feet pressed into the platform.
Drive your torso back against the pad until you return to an upright position.
Repeat smoothly without bouncing or jerking the pad.
commonMistakes: Using momentum and bouncing out of the bottom position
Pushing through a short, rushed range of motion
Letting the feet lift or shift on the platform
Hyperextending far past upright at the top
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body size and range of motion. Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured. Place your hands on the handles or grip bars. Engage your core and slowly lean forward, allowing your back to round slightly. Pause for a moment at the bottom position, feeling a stretch in your lower back. Using your back muscles, slowly raise your torso back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lean forward, then exhale as you extend back to an upright position.

records.name: 器械高位划船
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles start around upper-chest height when you sit down.
Sit with your chest firmly against the pad and place your feet flat on the platform.
Grab the handles with an overhand grip and straighten your arms without lifting your chest off the pad.
Pull the handles back toward your upper ribs by driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
Return the handles forward under control until your arms are straight again.
commonMistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears as you pull
Leaning off the chest pad to move the weight
Letting the handles slam forward between reps
Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them neutral
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and foot platform to a comfortable position. Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the foot platform. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and engage your core. Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull the handles toward you, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

records.name: 水平器械腿举
steps: Sit on the leg press and adjust seat as needed.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on platform.
Push platform away by extending legs.
Do not lock knees at the top position.
Lower platform under control to start position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the leg press machine with your feet hip-width apart on the platform. Press the platform away by extending your legs, but avoid locking your knees, then lower slowly back to the starting position.
formCues: Keep lower back pressed into seat
records.breathing: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 上斜器械中立握推胸
steps: Adjust seat height for optimal handle position.
Sit and grip handles with elbows bent.
Press handles up and forward above chest.
Avoid locking elbows completely.
Lower handles slowly to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest when seated. Grip the handles firmly and press them up and slightly forward, focusing on squeezing your upper chest. Return to the starting position under control after a brief pause.
records.breathing: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 器械跪姿腿弯举
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point and your ankles sit securely under the pads.
Kneel on the pad facing the machine, brace your torso against the support, and grip the handles.
Start with your legs extended behind you and keep your hips still.
Curl your heels up toward your glutes by bending your knees against the pads.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your hamstrings.
Lower the pads under control until your legs are straight again.
commonMistakes: Lifting the hips off the pad during the curl
Swinging the legs to start each rep
Stopping short and not straightening the knees at the bottom
Letting the ankles slip out of the pads
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight. Kneel on the machine facing downwards, with your knees resting on the pad and your feet secured under the footpads. Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability. Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings. Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position, fully extending your knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
formCues: Move slowly on the way down
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl your heels up, and inhale as you lower back to the start.

records.name: 器械侧平举
steps: Adjust the seat so the machine arms line up with your shoulders when you sit down.
Sit with your back against the pad and place your forearms or hands on the machine pads or handles.
Start with your arms down at your sides and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Raise the machine arms out to your sides until your upper arms reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower the arms back down under control to the starting position.
commonMistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Swinging or bouncing the weight at the bottom
Lifting the arms far above shoulder height
Letting the back come off the pad
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight. Exhale and raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor. Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your arms back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you raise the arms out to the sides, and inhale as you lower them back down.

records.name: 坐姿腿屈伸
steps: Adjust the seat and backrest so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
Sit back against the pad and place your shins behind the lower roller pad.
Grip the handles and start with your knees bent and feet pointed forward.
Straighten your knees to lift the pad until your legs are nearly straight.
Pause briefly while keeping your thighs pressed into the seat.
Lower the pad with control until your knees are bent again.
commonMistakes: Knees sit too far forward or behind the machine pivot.
Swinging the weight up with momentum.
Locking the knees hard at the top.
Lifting the hips or lower back off the seat.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the machine to fit your body. Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footpad. Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability. Extend your legs forward by straightening your knees, lifting the weight. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the weight back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you straighten your knees, and inhale as you lower the pad back down.

records.name: 器械仰卧推胸
steps: Lie supine on the machine bench.
Grip the handles firmly, elbows bent.
Engage chest and press handles forward and up.
Fully extend arms without locking out elbows.
Slowly return to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Lie back on the lever chest press machine, gripping the handles just outside shoulder-width. Press the levers forward and upward by extending your arms fully, focusing on squeezing your chest, then return with control to the starting position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 俯卧腿弯举
steps: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the pad rests against the back of your lower legs above your heels.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and grab the handles or bench edges for support.
Press your hips into the pad and point your toes forward to set your start position.
Curl the pad upward by bending your knees until your heels move toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your hips down and thighs on the pad.
Lower the pad back down under control until your legs are straight again.
commonMistakes: Lifting the hips off the pad at the top
Using momentum to swing the pad upward
Stopping short and not fully lowering the pad
Feet turning sharply inward or outward during the curl
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight. Lie face down on the machine with your legs straight and your heels against the padded lever. Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability. Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting your hips off the pad. Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings. Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
formCues: Move slow on the way down
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl the pad up, and inhale as you lower it back down under control.

records.name: 器械牧师凳弯举
steps: Adjust the seat so your armpits sit close to the top of the preacher pad.
Sit down and place the backs of your upper arms flat on the pad.
Grip the machine handles with an underhand grip and straighten your arms to the start.
Keep your chest up and curl the handles toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps briefly at the top without lifting your upper arms off the pad.
Lower the handles under control until your arms are nearly straight again.
commonMistakes: Upper arms lifting off the pad as the handles rise
Using the shoulders or rocking the torso to start the curl
Letting the weight drop quickly on the way down
Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them straight
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine. Place your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles with an underhand grip. Keep your back straight and your elbows positioned on the pad. Exhale and curl your forearms towards your upper arms, contracting your biceps. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps. Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl the handles up, and inhale as you lower them back down under control.

records.name: 器械反向背伸展
steps: Adjust the machine so your hips rest on the pad and your legs can hang freely.
Lie face down with your torso supported and grip the handles or sides for stability.
Place your feet against the foot pads and let your legs hang down under control.
Brace your midsection and squeeze your glutes to raise your legs behind you.
Lift until your legs are about in line with your torso without arching your lower back.
Lower your legs slowly to the start position and repeat.
commonMistakes: Swinging the legs up with momentum
Arching the lower back at the top
Letting the hips slide off the pad
Bending and straightening the knees during each rep
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the leverage machine to fit your body and secure your feet in the foot pads. Lie face down on the machine with your upper body hanging off the edge and your hips resting on the pad. Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head. Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your legs upward until they are parallel to the ground. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower your legs, and exhale as you raise them behind you.

records.name: 器械反向T杠划船
steps: Adjust the seat or chest pad so the handles line up around mid-chest when you reach forward.
Place your chest firmly against the pad and set your feet flat on the platform.
Grab the handles with an overhand grip and straighten your arms without rounding your shoulders.
Pull the handles toward your chest by driving your elbows back and out slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
Lower the handles under control until your arms are straight again.
commonMistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Bouncing the chest off the pad to move the handles
Letting the upper back round at the start
Yanking the weight and dropping it back fast
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position on the leverage machine. Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and engage your core. Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull the handles toward your chest, and inhale as you lower them back under control.

records.name: 坐姿器械提踵
steps: Adjust the seat so the thigh pad rests securely on your thighs with your knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place the balls of your feet on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grip the handles or seat and lift your heels to take the weight onto your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your toes planted.
Lower your heels slowly until you feel a stretch in your calves, then repeat.
commonMistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control.
Letting the knees shift up and down during the rep.
Rolling the feet outward or inward on the platform.
Using only a short top-half range of motion.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate. Place your toes on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge. Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability. Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press up onto the balls of your feet.

records.name: 器械卷腹
steps: Adjust seat and select appropriate resistance.
Sit back and secure feet and handles as designed.
Engage abs and flex spine forward in a crunch motion.
Bring chest toward knees while exhaling.
Control return to start and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Sit in the lever crunch machine and grasp the handles or position yourself according to machine design. Contract your abs to flex your spine forward, bringing your chest toward your knees, then return slowly to the starting position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you crunch down, inhale as you return up.

records.name: 器械坐姿臂屈伸
steps: Adjust the seat and select appropriate weight.
Sit down and grip the handles firmly.
Press the handles downward by extending your arms fully.
Pause briefly at lockout.
Return to the start position slowly.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the dip machine with your back against the pad, grip the handles, and position your feet flat on the platform. Press the handles downward by extending your arms, keeping your elbows close to your body, then return to the starting position in a controlled motion.
records.breathing: Exhale on pressing down, inhale on returning up.

records.name: 器械坐姿髋外展
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees bend about 90 degrees and the thigh pads rest against the outside of your legs.
Sit tall with your back against the pad, place your feet on the footrests, and grip the handles.
Start with your legs together and your knees aligned with the machine's pivot.
Drive your knees outward against the pads until your legs are as wide as your comfortable range allows.
Pause briefly with your hips still on the seat.
Bring your legs back together slowly until the pads nearly touch, then repeat.
commonMistakes: Leaning the torso forward or rocking back to move the weight.
Letting the legs snap back together on the return.
Lifting the hips off the seat at the widest point.
Turning the feet excessively to cheat the movement.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle. Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests. Place your hands on the side handles for stability. Engage your abductors and slowly push your legs apart, away from the midline of your body. Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your legs back together to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you press your knees outward, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

records.name: 器械坐姿髋内收
steps: Adjust the seat and pads so your knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
Sit tall with your back against the pad, place your legs outside the thigh pads, and grab the handles.
Set your feet flat on the footrests and start with your legs comfortably apart.
Bring your legs together by pressing inward against the pads.
Squeeze your inner thighs briefly when the pads come together.
Return the pads outward slowly until you reach the start position without letting the weight slam.
commonMistakes: Leaning forward or lifting the lower back off the pad.
Letting the pads fly open on the way back.
Using short, bouncing reps instead of controlled motion.
Turning the feet and knees excessively to force the movement.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest. Place your feet on the footrests and grasp the handles for stability. Engage your adductor muscles and slowly bring your legs together, squeezing your inner thighs. Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you press your legs together, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

records.name: 坐姿腿弯举
steps: Adjust the seat and pad so your knees line up with the machine’s pivot point.
Sit back against the pad and place your lower legs under the roller just above your ankles.
Grip the handles and keep your thighs pressed into the seat.
Curl the pad down by bending your knees until your heels move toward the floor.
Pause briefly and squeeze your hamstrings at the bottom.
Lower the pad back up with control until your knees are nearly straight.
commonMistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat during the curl.
Using momentum and swinging the pad through the rep.
Letting the knees fully lock out at the top.
Setting the pad too high on the calves instead of above the ankles.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest. Place your lower legs under the padded lever, just above your ankles. Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support. Keeping your upper legs stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible. Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings. Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl the pad down, and inhale as you return it to the starting position.

records.name: 器械坐姿反向飞鸟
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are about shoulder height when you sit down.
Sit with your chest against the pad, feet flat on the floor, and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
Start with your arms in front of you and keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your upper arms line up with your shoulders.
Squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back at the end of the movement.
Return the handles slowly to the start without letting the weight slam down.
commonMistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Straightening the elbows and turning it into a press
Letting the chest come off the pad
Swinging the handles back with momentum
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent. Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body. Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull the handles back, and inhale as you return to the starting position.

records.name: 器械耸肩
steps: Adjust the machine so the handles rest at your sides with your shoulders relaxed.
Sit or stand against the pad and grasp the handles with a firm overhand grip.
Straighten your arms and set your chest tall with your neck neutral.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending your elbows.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your torso still.
Lower your shoulders under control until they return to the start.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows and turning it into a row
Rolling the shoulders forward or backward
Leaning the torso to move the weight
Jutting the chin forward as the shoulders rise
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine with your back against the pad. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight. Keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible. Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you shrug your shoulders up, then inhale as you lower back down.

records.name: 器械站姿提踵
steps: Adjust the shoulder pads so they rest comfortably on your shoulders when you stand on the platform.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform with your heels hanging off and grip the handles.
Straighten your legs, brace your torso, and let your heels lower until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top while staying balanced under the pads.
Lower your heels under control back to the stretched start position.
commonMistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control.
Bending the knees noticeably during the raise.
Rolling the ankles inward or outward as the heels lift.
Using a short range and stopping before the heels fully lower.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability. Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press up onto the balls of your feet.

records.name: 器械站姿髋伸展
steps: Adjust the machine to your height.
Place one foot on platform, chest against pad.
Brace core and grasp handles for balance.
Extend hip, pressing lever back with heel.
Return to starting position and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Position yourself on the standing hip extension machine so one foot is on the lever platform. Brace your core and press the platform straight back using your heel, extending your hip fully. Lower under control and repeat for reps before switching legs.
records.breathing: Exhale as you extend hip, inhale as you return.

records.name: 器械站姿后踢腿
steps: Adjust the lever machine pad to chest height and select weight.
Place working foot on the platform.
Hold handles and brace core.
Extend hip by pushing foot backward as far as comfortable.
Return slowly to starting position and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Set up at the rear kick lever machine with your working foot on the platform and your chest against the pad. Push the lever backward by extending your hip, squeezing your glutes at the top, then return to the starting position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you kick back, inhale as you return.

records.name: T杠划船
steps: Lie prone on the chest pad of the T-bar row machine and grasp the handles.
Brace your upper body and retract your shoulder blades.
Pull the handles toward your chest or lower ribs.
Pause and squeeze your back at the top.
Lower the weight under control to a full stretch.
records.originalInstructions: Position yourself on the lever T-bar row machine with chest supported and feet braced. Grip the handles, retract your shoulder blades, and pull the handles toward your torso, squeezing your back muscles. Lower the weight under control with full stretch.
records.breathing: Exhale as you row up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 器械肱三头肌伸展
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with about eye or forehead level when you sit down.
Sit with your back against the pad and place your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with your palms facing down and straighten your arms in front of you.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the handles toward your forehead.
Pause briefly when your elbows are fully bent and the handles are close to your head.
Press the handles away by straightening your elbows until your arms are extended again.
commonMistakes: Elbows flare wide out to the sides.
Shoulders roll forward and the chest collapses.
Handles are dropped quickly toward the head.
Upper arms swing back and forth during the rep.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and fully extend your arms in front of you. Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the handles towards your forehead by bending your elbows. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the handles back up to the starting position by extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you bend your elbows to lower the handles, and exhale as you straighten your arms to press them away.

records.name: 瑞士球仰卧抬髋
records.englishName: Lying Hip Lift on Stability Ball
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and feet on the stability ball.
Bend knees at 90 degrees and keep feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
Pause at the top, keeping your body in a straight line.
Lower your hips back down with control.
records.originalInstructions: Lie with your upper back and arms on the floor and your feet on a stability ball. Brace your core, drive through your heels, and lift your hips to form a straight line from shoulders to knees, then lower back down with control.
records.breathing: Exhale when lifting hips, inhale when lowering hips.

records.name: 仰卧举腿（来源变式·0865）
steps: Lie flat on your back, legs straight.
Keep arms at your sides or under hips.
Lift legs upward, keeping knees straight.
Raise legs until hips come up slightly.
Lower legs slowly without touching the floor.
commonMistakes: Touching feet to ground between reps
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms at your sides or under your hips for support. Keeping legs straight, raise them toward the ceiling until your hips lift slightly off the floor, then lower them back down without touching the ground.
records.breathing: Exhale as you raise legs, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 侧卧股四头肌拉伸
steps: Lie on your stomach with legs extended.
Bend one knee, bringing heel toward glute.
Reach back and grasp ankle with hand.
Gently pull heel closer to glute until a stretch is felt.
Hold, then switch sides.
records.originalInstructions: Lie face down and grasp one ankle behind you, gently pulling the heel toward your glutes while keeping hips down. Feel a stretch in the front thigh and hold without straining the knee.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull, inhale to release.

records.name: 仰卧剪刀腿
steps: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides.
Lift both legs a few inches off the ground, keeping them straight.
Alternate raising one leg while lowering the other in a scissor motion.
Continue to alternate legs in a controlled manner.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed, core engaged.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with arms at your sides, legs extended. Lift both legs slightly off the ground, then alternately move one leg up and the other down in a controlled, fluttering motion.
records.breathing: Exhale as legs rise, inhale as legs lower.

records.name: 仰卧直腿抬腿
steps: Lie flat on your back, arms at sides.
Extend legs fully, feet together.
Lift legs straight up to vertical.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower legs down slowly but don’t touch floor.
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and arms at your sides. Keeping legs straight and together, lift them to about 90 degrees, then lower under control without letting heels touch the ground.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift legs, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 药球靠墙仰卧起坐
steps: Sit on the floor facing a wall, knees bent.
Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Lie back, then perform a sit-up.
At the top, throw the ball against the wall.
Catch the rebound and lower back down.
records.originalInstructions: Sit facing a wall with your knees bent, holding a medicine ball at your chest. Perform a sit-up and, at the top, throw the medicine ball against the wall, catch it as it rebounds, then lower back down and repeat.
records.breathing: Exhale as you sit up/throw, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 中背部拉伸
steps: Sit or stand with feet hip-width apart.
Extend your arms straight in front and clasp your hands.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward.
Tuck your chin slightly toward your chest.
Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds and release.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back instead of rounding the upper back
records.originalInstructions: Sit or stand with arms extended in front. Clasp your hands and round your upper back, reaching forward to feel a gentle stretch along your middle back. Hold the position without bouncing.
records.breathing: Breathe slowly and evenly throughout the stretch.

records.name: 站姿杠铃推举
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and barbell at shoulder height.
Grip the bar with hands just outside shoulder-width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the barbell overhead to full arm extension.
Lower the bar slowly back to shoulders.
records.originalInstructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip. Press the bar overhead by extending your arms fully, keeping your core tight and avoiding excessive lower back arch. Lower the bar to the starting position under control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 颈侧拉伸
steps: Sit or stand with good posture.
Slowly tilt your head to one side, ear towards shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Return to center.
Repeat on the opposite side.
commonMistakes: Turning the head instead of tilting
records.originalInstructions: Sit or stand upright, keeping good posture. Gently tilt your head toward one shoulder until a stretch is felt along the opposite side of the neck, holding for a set duration before switching sides.
records.breathing: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

records.name: 复古反向臂屈伸
steps: Lie face down on the floor or bench with elbows bent and hands at your sides.
Position elbows by your torso.
Straighten your arms fully behind you, contracting your triceps.
Pause and squeeze at full extension.
Return to the start in a controlled manner.
records.originalInstructions: Lie face down on the floor or bench with arms bent and hands under shoulders. Extend your arms straight back by pressing your palms into the ground or lifting them off the ground, fully straightening your elbows and contracting your triceps. Lower back down under control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you extend your arms, inhale as you return.

records.name: 奥蒂斯负重仰卧起坐
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet anchored.
Hold a weight with both hands, arms fully extended above your chest.
Engage your core and sit up, keeping arms straight and weight overhead.
Reach an upright seated position.
Lower yourself back down under control with arms extended.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding a weight plate or dumbbell above your chest with arms extended. Sit up while keeping the weight overhead at arm's length, then lower back down under control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 过顶胸部拉伸
steps: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart.
Interlace fingers and stretch arms straight overhead.
Gently pull arms back behind head.
Squeeze shoulder blades together.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
records.originalInstructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, interlace your fingers and extend your arms overhead. Gently pull your arms back and upward, feeling a stretch in your chest and shoulders.
records.breathing: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

records.name: 蝴蝶机夹胸
steps: Adjust seat and sit with back against pad.
Place forearms on pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring arms together in a wide arc.
Squeeze chest at the end of movement.
Return slowly to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the pec deck machine with forearms against the pads and elbows slightly bent. Bring the arms together by contracting the chest, then slowly return to the starting position while maintaining control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you bring arms together, inhale as you open.

records.name: 腓骨肌拉伸
steps: Sit with one leg crossed over the other.
Grasp the foot and gently pull it inward.
Turn the sole toward your midline.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Sit or stand and cross one leg over the other, gently turning the sole of the foot inwards to feel a stretch along the outside of the lower leg. Hold the stretch, then repeat on the other side.
records.breathing: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

records.name: 普拉提螺旋式
steps: Lie on back, arms by side, legs straight up.
Engage core, lift hips off mat gently.
Circle legs together in a clockwise motion.
Lower hips as legs complete the circle.
Reverse the circle direction.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with arms at your sides and legs extended overhead. Lift your hips slightly off the mat, then circle your legs in a controlled motion, using your core to stabilize and reverse the direction after each circle.
records.breathing: Exhale as you circle legs, inhale to prepare.

records.name: 普拉提百次拍击
steps: Lie on back, legs in tabletop or extended.
Lift head, neck, shoulders off mat.
Extend arms at sides, hovering above floor.
Pump arms up and down vigorously.
Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5 pumps; repeat to 100.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with legs extended or in tabletop position. Lift your head, neck, and shoulders off the mat, extend arms, and pulse them up and down in small, quick movements while holding the core contracted for 100 counts.
records.breathing: Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5 pumps, continue cycle.

records.name: 弹动侧弓步拉伸
steps: Stand with feet wider than hip-width apart.
Shift your weight to one side, bending the knee and keeping the opposite leg straight.
Drop into a deep lunge while maintaining upright posture.
Push off the bent leg and return to starting position.
Repeat to the opposite side in a dynamic, alternating fashion.
records.originalInstructions: Begin standing with feet shoulder-width apart. Step to the side into a deep lunge, keeping the opposite leg straight, and quickly alternate sides in a rhythmic motion.
records.breathing: Inhale as you prepare and exhale moving into each lunge.

records.name: 宽握引体向上
steps: Grip pull-up bar with hands wider than shoulders, palms overhand.
Hang with arms fully extended and core tight.
Pull chest up to bar, driving elbows down and out.
Pause at the top, squeeze back muscles.
Lower down slowly to full extension.
records.originalInstructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with hands wider than shoulders using an overhand grip. Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar, then lower slowly.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 引体向上组合（正握与反握）
steps: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with your chosen grip (overhand for pull-up, underhand for chin-up).
Hang at full arm extension with shoulders engaged.
Brace your core and pull your chest up toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Clear the bar with your chin or chest as you squeeze your lats.
Lower yourself under control to the starting hang position.
records.originalInstructions: Grab a pull-up bar with either a pronated (overhand, pull-up) or supinated (underhand, chin-up) grip slightly wider or narrower than shoulder width as desired. Start from a dead hang, retract your shoulders, and pull your chin above the bar using your back and arms. Control your descent back to the bottom.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 俯卧撑
steps: Begin in a plank with hands under shoulders.
Engage core and glutes.
Lower chest toward floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Pause briefly when close to ground.
Press back up to plank position.
records.originalInstructions: Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Lower your body by bending elbows until your chest nearly touches the floor, then push back to the starting position while keeping your core engaged.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower, exhale as you push up.

records.name: 后倾下斜桥式
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your arms by your sides and press your palms lightly into the floor.
Brace your midsection and squeeze your glutes.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your knees, hips, and shoulders line up.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your ribs down.
Lower your hips to the floor with control and reset before the next rep.
commonMistakes: Pushing through the toes so the heels lift
Overarching the lower back at the top
Dropping the hips quickly to the floor
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent. Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down. Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders. Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale at the bottom, exhale as you lift your hips, and inhale again as you lower with control.

records.name: 肩后束拉伸
steps: Extend one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Use opposite hand to pull arm towards your body.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release and return to start.
Repeat on the other side.
records.originalInstructions: Stand or sit upright, extend one arm across your body at shoulder height and use the opposite hand to pull it closer, feeling a stretch across the back of the shoulder. Hold, then switch sides.
records.breathing: Breathe normally throughout the stretch.

records.name: 后脚垫高髋屈肌拉伸
records.englishName: Rear Foot Elevated Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Stand with your back to a bench; place one foot on the bench.
Step the front foot forward and lower into a lunge.
Tuck pelvis under, keeping chest tall.
Lean gently forward to intensify the stretch.
Hold, then switch legs.
records.originalInstructions: Stand facing away from a bench or sturdy platform. Place one foot on the bench behind you and lower into a lunge, feeling a stretch in the hip flexors of the elevated leg. Keep your torso upright and pelvis tucked for maximum benefit.
records.breathing: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you sink into the stretch.

records.name: 弹力带高位夹胸
steps: Anchor resistance band above shoulder height.
Grasp handles and step forward for tension.
Start with arms raised wide, aligned with shoulders.
Pull arms downward and together in a wide arc.
Squeeze chest, then return slowly to start.
records.originalInstructions: Attach bands above head height and hold one handle in each hand. Stand with arms overhead in a wide position, then pull hands down and together in an arc, squeezing the chest. Return slowly to the start.
records.breathing: Exhale as you bring arms together, inhale as you return.

records.name: 反向卷腹
steps: Lie on your back, arms at your sides, knees bent, and feet off the ground.
Engage your core and lift your legs, bringing knees toward your chest.
Lift hips off the floor in a curling motion.
Pause and squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower your hips back down slowly, keeping control.
commonMistakes: Letting lower back arch off the floor
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and knees bent at 90 degrees. Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest, then slowly lower back to the starting position without letting your feet touch the floor.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift hips, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 反向臂屈伸位拉伸
steps: Sit with legs extended and arms behind your hips.
Place hands flat on the floor, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your palms to lift your chest up.
Keep your arms long without locking elbows.
Hold for the stretch, then slowly lower and relax.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and place your hands behind you with fingers facing forward. Gently press through your palms to lift your chest and feel the stretch across your upper arms and shoulders, holding the position without hyperextending your elbows.
records.breathing: Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch.

records.name: 反握器械高位下拉
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees fit snugly under the pads and place your feet flat on the floor.
Reach up and grab the handles with an underhand grip about shoulder-width apart.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms fully extended overhead.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your upper back and lats at the bottom without leaning far backward.
Slowly let the handles rise until your arms are straight again while keeping control.
commonMistakes: Leaning far back and turning it into a row
Pulling the handles behind the neck
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Letting the weight slam back at the top
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground. Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back. Pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as the handles rise back up, and exhale as you pull them down toward your chest.

records.name: 反握引体向上
steps: Grab the bar with palms facing you (supinated grip), hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang with arms fully extended and scapula engaged.
Pull your chest up towards the bar, leading with your elbows.
Clear your chin above the bar, squeezing at the top.
Lower yourself back to the starting position with control.
records.originalInstructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width, underhand (supinated) grip. Pull your chin above the bar by flexing your elbows and squeezing your lats, then lower under control.
records.breathing: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering down.

records.name: 反握绳索高位下拉
steps: Set the cable bar attachment and sit with knees secured under the pad.
Grasp the bar with a reverse (supinated) shoulder-width grip.
Lean back slightly, chest up, arms fully extended.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest by contracting your lats.
Slowly return the bar to the start position with control.
records.originalInstructions: Sit at a lat pulldown station and grasp the bar with a reverse (underhand) grip, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull the bar down to your upper chest, squeezing the shoulder blades together, then slowly return to starting position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return up.

records.name: 吊环高位划船
steps: Adjust rings to chest height and grip handles with neutral grip.
Lean back with feet forward and body straight.
Engage core, keep arms extended.
Row your chest toward the rings, retracting shoulder blades.
Lower body back to start under control.
records.originalInstructions: Set up rings at an appropriate height and grip handles with palms facing in. Lean back with body rigid, arms extended, and feet forward. Pull your chest up to ring height, squeezing the shoulder blades together, then lower back under control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 转体俯卧撑
steps: Begin in a standard push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
As you press up, rotate your torso and lift one arm toward the ceiling.
Hold briefly, keeping hips square.
Return to start, repeat on the other side.
records.originalInstructions: From a push-up position, lower down as normal. As you press up, rotate your torso and extend one arm toward the ceiling, forming a T with your arms. Return to push-up position and repeat to the other side.
records.breathing: Exhale when pushing up and rotating, inhale when lowering.

records.name: 跑者拉伸
steps: Step one foot forward into a lunge, keeping the rear leg extended.
Place both hands on either side of the front foot.
Lower your hips gently, keeping back leg straight.
Lift your chest for deeper stretch.
Hold, then switch legs.
records.originalInstructions: Begin in a lunge position with one foot forward and the other leg extended back, keeping both hands on the floor. Sink your hips low toward the ground while keeping your chest lifted, feeling a stretch in the hip flexor of your rear leg and hamstring of your front leg.
records.breathing: Inhale as you get into position, exhale as you deepen the stretch.

records.name: 跑步
steps: Warm up with light walking or dynamic stretches.
Begin running at a moderate pace.
Maintain a steady breathing rhythm and upright posture.
Land lightly with a midfoot or forefoot strike.
Cool down with walking and stretching.
records.originalInstructions: Begin at a comfortable pace, maintaining upright posture and relaxed shoulders. Land lightly on your feet and use a natural arm swing for balance, adjusting speed and distance as fitness improves.
records.breathing: Exhale steadily as you push off, inhale as you recover.

records.name: 瑞士球直臂俄罗斯转体
records.englishName: Russian Twist on Stability Ball (Arms Straight)
aliases: Russian Twist (on stability ball arms straight)
steps: Sit on a stability ball and walk feet forward until shoulders rest on the ball.
Keep knees bent at 90 degrees, hips lifted in a bridge position.
Extend arms straight toward the ceiling with hands together.
Rotate torso and arms as one unit to the left.
Return to center, then rotate to the right, repeating for reps.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on a stability ball with feet flat on the ground, then walk feet forward to roll down until your upper back is supported. Extend your arms straight in front and rotate your torso side to side, keeping arms aligned and abs engaged throughout.
records.breathing: Exhale during each rotation, inhale as you return to center.

records.name: 肩胛双杠下沉
steps: Start in a straight-arm support on parallel bars or dip bars with your elbows locked and shoulders stacked over your hands.
Lift your chest and brace your trunk while keeping your legs still under you.
Lower your body a few inches by letting your shoulders rise toward your ears without bending your elbows.
Press down through your hands to pull your shoulders away from your ears and raise your body back up.
Repeat with slow, controlled shoulder movement while keeping your arms straight the whole time.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows like a regular dip
Swinging the legs or torso to create momentum
Shrugging up and never pressing back down
Dropping too far and losing shoulder control
records.originalInstructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight. Lower your body by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to squeeze a pencil between them. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to extend your elbows and return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower into the shoulder shrug, and exhale as you press down to lift your body back up.

records.name: 坐姿交替哑铃弯举
steps: Sit with back against support and feet flat.
Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell while rotating palm up.
Lower to starting position and alternate arms.
Repeat, keeping back straight and elbows close to sides.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on a bench with back support holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Curl one dumbbell by flexing the elbow, then lower it and repeat with the opposite arm, keeping your torso stable.
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 坐姿俯身背部拉伸
steps: Sit comfortably on the floor, legs extended or crossed.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping back relaxed.
Let arms reach forward toward feet or floor.
Lower your chest toward your knees, breathing deeply.
Hold the stretch and relax into the position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended or crossed. Hinge at the hips and slowly bend forward, reaching hands toward feet or out in front, keeping the back as relaxed as comfortable. Hold the stretch to gently lengthen the muscles along the spine.
records.breathing: Inhale before bending, exhale as you fold forward.

records.name: 坐姿船式拉伸
steps: Sit on the floor with back straight.
Bring soles of feet together and let knees drop out.
Hold ankles or feet for support.
Gently pull feet closer and lean forward slightly.
Hold position without bouncing.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together, letting knees fall out to the sides. Hold your feet or ankles and gently pull them in, leaning forward slightly to deepen the stretch through the groin and hips.
formCues: Go only as far as comfortable
records.breathing: Breathe deeply and regularly while holding the stretch.

records.name: V把坐姿绳索划船
aliases: cable reverse-grip straight back seated high row
steps: Sit on the cable row machine and place feet on the foot platform.
Grab the V-grip handle with both hands, arms extended.
Maintain a straight back and slight knee bend.
