Pull the handle toward your abdomen, retracting your shoulder blades.
Slowly extend arms to return to the starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on a cable row station with feet on the platform and grasp the V-grip handle. Keep your back straight and pull the handle towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blades and bending your elbows. Control the return to the starting position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you row back, inhale as you extend forward.

records.name: 宽握坐姿绳索划船
steps: Sit down and place feet against the platform.
Grasp the wide grip attachment with both hands.
Keep your torso upright, arms fully extended.
Pull the handle toward your upper abdomen, squeezing your upper back.
Slowly release back to the start position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the cable row machine with feet on the platform and grab the wide grip handle. Pull the bar towards the upper abdomen, retracting the shoulder blades, and return to the starting position with control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you extend arms.

records.name: 坐姿小腿拉伸
steps: Sit with legs extended straight in front.
Loop a towel or band around one foot's ball.
Keep knee straight and pull your toes toward you.
Hold position, feeling stretch in calf.
Repeat on the other leg.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended. Loop a towel or band around the ball of one foot, keeping your knee straight, and gently pull your toes toward you, feeling a stretch in the calf. Hold and repeat on the other side.
records.breathing: Breathe steadily and deeply throughout the stretch.

records.name: 坐姿哑铃肩上推举
steps: Sit on a bench with back support and feet flat.
Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows bent.
Press dumbbells overhead until arms are extended.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower dumbbells to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit upright with back supported and hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward. Press the weights up overhead until arms are extended, then lower back down under control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 坐姿下背部拉伸
steps: Sit with legs extended or crossed.
Reach both arms straight in front of you.
Slowly bend at your hips to lower your torso forward.
Relax your back and shoulders.
Hold stretch, then return to upright position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor or chair with your legs extended or crossed. Reach both arms forward and slowly bend at the hips, lowering your torso and arms toward your feet, feeling the stretch across your lower back. Hold the position, keeping the back relaxed.
records.breathing: Inhale deeply before bending, exhale as you reach forward.

records.name: 坐姿肩部屈曲下沉后缩拉伸
records.englishName: Seated Shoulder Flexor, Depressor, Retractor Stretch
aliases: Stretching - Seated Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor
roller seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor
steps: Sit tall with feet flat.
Lift arms overhead, reaching upward.
Gently depress the shoulders away from your ears.
Retract shoulder blades by pulling them slightly together.
Hold for a stretch, breathing evenly.
records.originalInstructions: Sit upright on the floor or a chair with feet flat. Reach one or both arms overhead, then gently pull the shoulders downward and backward to open the chest and lengthen the front and rear deltoids. Maintain a tall posture and breathe deeply.
records.breathing: Inhale to begin, exhale as you stretch deeper.

records.name: 坐姿直臂转体
steps: Sit with knees bent, feet either flat or off the ground.
Extend arms straight forward, clasping hands.
Lean back slightly with a neutral spine.
Rotate torso to one side, arms following movement.
Return to center and repeat to opposite side.
commonMistakes: Using just arms instead of rotating the torso
Moving too quickly or without control
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet elevated or flat. Extend both arms straight out in front of you, clasping your hands together. Rotate your torso to one side, keeping arms straight, then rotate to the other side while engaging your core throughout.
records.breathing: Exhale as you twist, inhale returning to center.

records.name: 瑞士球坐姿转体
steps: Sit on a stability ball with feet flat, core engaged.
Hold arms in front or across chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping hips stationary.
Pause, then twist to the left.
Return to center, repeat alternately.
records.originalInstructions: Sit upright on a stability ball, feet flat and hip-width apart. Twist your torso to one side while keeping hips steady, then return to center and repeat on the other side.
records.breathing: Exhale during the twist, inhale as you return to center.

records.name: 坐姿直臂转体拉伸
steps: Sit upright with legs extended forward.
Cross your left leg over your right if desired for more stretch.
Extend your right arm straight behind you for support.
Twist your torso toward your right, using the opposite arm for leverage.
Hold, then repeat to the other side.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and back straight. Extend your right arm behind you and twist your torso to the right, keeping your left arm straight across your knee for leverage, hold, and repeat on the other side.
records.breathing: Breathe steadily while holding the stretch.

records.name: 坐姿宽角式连续动作
aliases: Stretching - Seated Wide Angle Pose Sequence
steps: Sit with legs extended wide apart.
Keep knees and toes pointing upward.
Sit tall and hinge forward at hips.
Walk hands forward, maintaining flat back.
Hold stretch or gently move side to side.
records.originalInstructions: Sit upright and spread your legs as wide as is comfortable. With a straight back, hinge forward at the hips and walk your hands out in front or toward each leg, deepening the stretch in the inner thighs and lower back. Carefully progress through variations to target various muscle groups.
records.breathing: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you stretch forward.

records.name: 肩宽握距引体向上
steps: Grip bar shoulder-width, palms away.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Pull up until chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower down slowly to full extension.
records.originalInstructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing away. Initiate movement from the back and pull your chin over the bar, then lower yourself in a controlled manner back to the starting position.
records.breathing: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering down.

records.name: 瑞士球侧屈
steps: Position yourself sideways on a stability ball, feet braced.
Place top hand behind head, other hand for balance.
Lower your torso over the ball for a stretch.
Contract your side to lift torso up in a side bend.
Lower back down with control, repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Lie sideways over a stability ball, feet anchored, and hands behind head. Crunch your torso upward in a side-bending motion, then lower with control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 站姿侧屈拉伸
steps: Stand or sit tall with spine neutral.
Raise right arm overhead.
Slowly bend torso to the left, keeping hips steady.
Hold stretch for time, feeling the pull in your side.
Return to start and repeat on the other side.
records.originalInstructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart or sit upright. Raise one arm overhead and lean to the opposite side, feeling a stretch along your side and back muscles. Hold briefly, then return to start and repeat on the other side.
records.breathing: Exhale as you bend, inhale as you return to upright.

records.name: 侧平板支撑
steps: Lie on your side, elbow stacked under shoulder.
Stack your feet or place one in front of the other.
Raise hips up to create a straight line.
Hold body in line, keeping abs and glutes engaged.
Lower hips gently to finish; switch sides.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs extended. Lift your hips off the ground to form a straight line from head to feet, bracing your abs and holding the position while breathing steadily.
records.breathing: Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

records.name: 手腕侧向牵拉
steps: Stand or sit tall.
Extend one arm overhead or outward.
Hold your wrist with the opposite hand.
Pull gently toward one side.
Hold, then switch sides.
records.originalInstructions: Stand or sit upright, extend one arm overhead or to the side, and grasp the wrist with your opposite hand. Gently pull the wrist to the side to stretch the forearm and wrist muscles, avoiding excessive force.
records.breathing: Exhale as you stretch, inhale to reset or switch sides.

records.name: 单哑铃直腿硬拉
steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell with both hands at your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat.
Hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the floor.
Pause at the bottom while feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Return to the upright position by driving hips forward.
records.originalInstructions: Stand holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs. With a slight bend at the knees, hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings and then return to the starting position.
records.breathing: Inhale lowering, exhale as you stand back up.

records.name: 单腿屈膝拉伸
steps: Lie on your back with both legs bent.
Grasp one knee with both hands.
Pull the knee toward your chest gently.
Hold the stretch, keeping your back flat.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent. Grip one shin and gently pull that knee towards your chest, feeling the stretch in your hip and glutes. Maintain a neutral spine and hold before switching legs.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull the knee in, inhale as you release.

records.name: 单腿直膝拉伸
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg up while keeping it straight.
Hold the back of your thigh or calf gently.
Pull the leg slightly toward your chest.
Hold and switch legs.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back, legs extended. Lift one leg straight up, keeping it as straight as possible, and hold the calf or thigh to gently pull it closer, feeling a stretch in the hamstrings and calves. Then switch legs.
formCues: Point or flex foot for deeper stretch
records.breathing: Exhale as you stretch the leg, inhale as you lower it.

records.name: 仰卧起坐（来源变式一）
steps: Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet anchored.
Place hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your core to lift your torso to a seated position.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Place your hands behind your head or across your chest, engage your core, and lift your torso all the way up to your knees, then lower back down with control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 仰卧起坐（来源变式二）
steps: Lie down with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross arms over chest or place hands behind head.
Engage your core and raise your torso towards your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slowly lower back to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Cross your arms over your chest or place hands behind your head, and use your abdominals to lift your upper body toward your knees, then lower back down with control.
records.breathing: Exhale on the ascent, inhale on the descent.

records.name: 45度腿举机提踵
steps: Sit in the 45-degree sled machine and place the balls of both feet on the lower edge of the platform with your heels hanging off.
Straighten your legs enough to support the sled and keep a small bend in your knees.
Let your heels drop down by bending at the ankles until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press through the balls of your feet and raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your legs steady.
Lower your heels under control back to the stretched position and repeat.
commonMistakes: Bending and straightening the knees instead of moving only at the ankles
Placing the whole foot flat on the platform so the heels cannot drop
Bouncing out of the bottom instead of lowering under control
Turning the toes excessively in or out during the rep
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle. Place your feet on the sled platform with your toes pointing forward. Push the sled platform away from you by extending your ankles and calves. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled platform back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
formCues: Drive through the balls of feet
Lift heels as high as possible
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower your heels, and exhale as you press through the balls of your feet to raise them.

records.name: 宽距器械腿举
steps: Adjust the seat and load desired weight.
Sit with your back and head against the pad, feet flat and wide on the platform.
Release the safety handles and grasp the side handles.
Bend your knees to lower the platform until your thighs reach 90 degrees or just past.
Press through your heels to extend your legs fully, but avoid locking out the knees.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on a 45-degree leg press machine with feet placed wider than hip-width on the platform. Push the platform up to release the safety handles and slowly lower it toward your chest, then drive through your heels to press the weight back up.
formCues: Keep knees in line with toes
Do not lock knees at top
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower the platform, exhale as you press it back up.

records.name: 哈克深蹲
steps: Stand on the sled platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the pads.
Place your feet about shoulder-width apart on the platform with toes turned slightly out, then grip the handles.
Unlock the sled and lower yourself by bending your knees and hips until your thighs reach parallel or your deepest controlled position.
Keep your full foot planted against the platform as your knees track in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels and midfoot to extend your knees and hips and return the sled upward.
Stop just short of locking your knees, then continue into the next repetition.
commonMistakes: Feet placed too low so the heels lift off the platform
Knees collapsing inward during the lowering phase
Lower back rounding or hips peeling off the pad
Bouncing out of the bottom instead of pausing briefly
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable position for your height. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards. Hold onto the handles or bars for stability. Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below. Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to raise your body back up to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower the sled, then exhale as you press it back up.

records.name: 史密斯椅式深蹲
steps: Set the Smith bar across your upper back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, slightly in front of the bar path.
Unrack the bar and brace your core with your chest up and eyes forward.
Bend your knees and hips together to sit straight down under control.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor or slightly below while keeping your heels down.
Drive through your midfoot and heels to stand back up until your knees and hips are fully extended.
Lock out tall, then repeat for the next rep.
commonMistakes: Feet set directly under the bar so the knees travel too far forward.
Heels lift off the floor at the bottom.
Knees cave inward during the ascent.
Lower back rounds as the hips drop.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to a comfortable position. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out. Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps. Engage your core and keep your chest up as you slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale and brace before you lower, then exhale as you drive back up to standing.

records.name: 史密斯提踵
aliases: smith one leg floor calf raise
steps: Set up the Smith machine bar at shoulder height.
Step under the bar, position it across your upper traps, and unrack.
Stand upright with feet hip to shoulder-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet by extending your ankles.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels in a controlled manner.
records.originalInstructions: Stand upright under the Smith machine bar, with the bar resting across your upper traps and feet shoulder-width apart. Raise your heels to stand on your toes, contract your calves, and slowly lower back to the ground.
records.breathing: Exhale as you rise, inhale as you lower.

records.name: 史密斯硬拉
steps: Position feet shoulder-width beneath the Smith bar.
Grip the bar just outside your knees with both hands.
Hinge hips back and lower torso, keeping chest up.
Extend hips and knees to lift the bar along the guides.
Lower the bar with control to the starting position.
commonMistakes: Lifting with arms instead of legs
Letting the bar drift away from body
records.originalInstructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart beneath the Smith bar. Hold the bar with an overhand grip, hinge at your hips, bend knees, and keep your back neutral. Extend hips and knees to lift the bar along the rails, then return slowly under control.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower the bar, exhale as you lift.

records.name: 史密斯腿举
steps: Set the safety stops and load the appropriate weight.
Lie under the Smith bar and position feet wider than shoulder-width on the bar.
Unrack the bar by rotating your feet upward.
Lower the bar slowly toward your torso until legs form roughly a 90-degree angle.
Press the bar up by extending your knees and hips.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on the floor or bench under a Smith machine with feet placed on the bar wider than shoulder-width. Unlock the bar and press upwards with your legs, lowering until your knees reach a 90-degree angle before pressing back to the start.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower the bar, exhale as you press upward.

records.name: 史密斯坐姿肩推
steps: Set a bench or seat under the Smith bar so the bar starts around shoulder height when you sit down.
Sit tall with your back supported, plant your feet flat, and grip the bar just wider than shoulder width with palms forward.
Unrack the bar and hold it above your upper chest with wrists stacked over elbows.
Lower the bar in a straight path until it reaches about chin to shoulder level.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower the bar with control to the start position and repeat.
Finish by locking out the top and rotating the bar to re-rack it on the hooks.
commonMistakes: Lowering the bar behind the head
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides
Arching the lower back off the bench
Letting the wrists bend back excessively
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height so that the handles are at shoulder level. Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor. Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and lift them off the supports, extending your arms fully. Lower the handles down to shoulder level, keeping your elbows slightly bent. Press the handles up overhead until your arms are fully extended. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to shoulder level. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower the bar to shoulder level, and exhale as you press it overhead.

records.name: 哑铃施法者转体
steps: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell with both hands in front of your hips.
Soften your knees and hinge slightly at your hips while keeping your chest up and back flat.
Rotate your torso and lower the dumbbell toward the outside of one foot.
Drive through your hips and return to the center with the dumbbell back in front of your hips.
Rotate to the other side and lower the dumbbell toward the outside of the opposite foot.
Continue alternating sides with controlled movement.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back as the dumbbell lowers
Bending mostly through the spine instead of hinging at the hips
Letting the knees cave inward during the reach
Swinging the dumbbell quickly instead of controlling each side
records.originalInstructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the waist, keeping your back straight. Extend your arm with the dumbbell towards the opposite foot, rotating your torso as you do so. Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower and rotate toward one foot, then exhale as you return to center and switch sides.

records.name: 脊柱前屈拉伸
steps: Sit on floor with legs extended and feet flexed.
Extend arms straight ahead at shoulder height.
Inhale, then as you exhale, reach forward, articulating your spine.
Stretch forward as far as comfortable, keeping legs straight.
Hold and return slowly to start.
records.originalInstructions: Sit with legs extended and feet flexed, arms extended in front of you. Exhale as you reach forward, articulating the spine and stretching through your fingertips. Hold the stretch, then slowly return to start.
records.breathing: Exhale as you stretch forward, inhale as you return to start.

records.name: 徒手深蹲
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly outward.
Brace core and keep chest up.
Initiate movement by pushing hips back and bending knees.
Descend until thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Push through heels to return to standing.
records.originalInstructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out. Lower your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair, keeping your chest upright, then drive through your heels to stand back up.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you stand up.

records.name: 瑞士球腿弯举
aliases: dumbbell one arm concentration curl (on stability ball)
steps: Lie face up on the floor, arms at your sides, heels on a stability ball.
Lift hips to form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Bend knees to roll the ball toward your glutes.
Pause and squeeze your hamstrings.
Extend your legs to roll the ball back out.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball. Lift your hips, then curl the ball toward your glutes by flexing your knees, and extend legs back out while keeping hips elevated.
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl in, inhale as you extend out.

records.name: 瑞士球垫腿卷腹
steps: Place stability ball in front of you and sit down.
Lie back and position your calves and feet on top of the ball with knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or crossed on your chest.
Engage your core and curl your upper body toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower back down without losing control.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with legs bent and calves resting on a stability ball, hands behind your head. Engage your core and lift your shoulders toward your knees, keeping your lower back on the floor, then return to the starting position.
formCues: Keep lower back pressed to floor
Do not pull with your neck
records.breathing: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 台阶小腿拉伸
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or stair.
Support yourself with a railing, wall, or sturdy object.
Lower your heels slowly below the step to feel a stretch in your calves.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Raise heels back up and repeat as desired.
records.originalInstructions: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off. Slowly lower your heels toward the ground, feeling the stretch in your calves. Hold, then return to starting position or alternate legs.
formCues: Keep knees straight but not locked
records.breathing: Exhale as you lower into the stretch, inhale as you return.

records.name: 站姿内收肌拉伸
steps: Stand wide with feet apart.
Shift weight to one leg, bending at the knee.
Keep the opposite leg straight and toes forward.
Lean gently toward the bent knee for a deep inner thigh stretch.
Hold, then switch to the other side.
records.originalInstructions: Stand with feet wide apart and slowly bend one knee while keeping the other leg straight. Lean into the bent knee side, feeling the stretch along your inner thigh. Hold, then switch sides.
records.breathing: Breathe deeply and steadily while holding the stretch.

records.name: 站姿背部转体拉伸
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend arms at shoulder height or place hands on hips.
Rotate torso gently to one side without moving hips.
Hold stretch for desired time.
Return to center and repeat on other side.
records.originalInstructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front or at your sides. Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, keeping hips square, to feel a gentle stretch along your back and waist. Hold, return to center, and repeat to the other side.
records.breathing: Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return to center.

records.name: 训练凳辅助小腿拉伸
steps: Stand in front of a bench or sturdy surface.
Place the ball of one foot onto the edge, keeping heel on the floor.
Lean your body forward while keeping your knee straight.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
commonMistakes: Letting the foot roll inward or outward
records.originalInstructions: Stand facing a bench and place your toes up onto the edge with your heel on the ground. Lean forward slightly until you feel a stretch through your calf. Hold for the desired time and repeat with the other leg.
formCues: Feel stretch in calf, not ankle
records.breathing: Exhale as you relax into the stretch, inhale as you ease off.

records.name: 站姿腘绳肌拉伸
steps: Stand up straight with feet hip-width apart.
Keep knees soft, and hinge forward at the hips.
Lower your torso toward your legs while reaching for your toes.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold for the desired duration, then return to standing.
records.originalInstructions: Stand tall and keep knees slightly bent. Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso while reaching towards your toes to feel a gentle stretch in your hamstrings. Hold the stretch without bouncing.
records.breathing: Exhale as you hinge forward, inhale as you return upright.

records.name: 站姿髋屈肌与腹部伸展
records.englishName: Standing Hip Flexor and Abdominal Stretch
steps: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lift arms overhead, palms facing forward.
Arch back gently, lifting chest and looking upward.
Shift hips forward slightly to increase hip flexor stretch.
Hold and breathe for desired duration.
records.originalInstructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart. Raise both arms overhead and gently arch your back, lifting your chest and looking up at the ceiling. Engage your glutes and extend hips forward to feel a stretch through the front of your hips and abdomen.
records.breathing: Inhale before arching; exhale as you hold the stretch.

records.name: 站姿抱膝拉伸
steps: Stand tall with feet together.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Grasp your knee with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, feeling the stretch.
Hold, then lower and repeat on the opposite leg.
records.originalInstructions: Stand upright and balance on one foot. Lift one knee up toward your chest, grasping it with both hands and pulling gently until you feel a stretch in the hip and glute. Hold briefly, lower, and repeat on the other leg.
formCues: Use arms to pull knee gently
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull the knee up, inhale as you release.

records.name: 站姿侧向拉伸
steps: Stand upright, feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead, keeping it straight.
Place other hand on hip or let it hang at side.
Gently lean to the opposite side, keeping hips square.
Hold, then return to center and repeat on the other side.
records.originalInstructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart; raise one arm overhead and gently lean to the opposite side. Feel a stretch along the side of your torso and hold, then switch sides.
records.breathing: Inhale to lengthen, exhale as you lean into the stretch.

records.name: 站姿股四头肌拉伸
steps: Stand upright, balancing on one foot.
Bend the opposite knee, reaching back for the foot.
Pull heel gently towards glute while keeping knees together.
Keep torso tall and hips level.
Hold the stretch, then switch legs.
records.originalInstructions: While standing, bend one knee and reach back to grasp your foot or ankle. Pull your heel towards your glutes while keeping your knees close together and torso upright. Use support if needed for balance.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull heel in, inhale as you release.

records.name: 站姿上举背部转体拉伸
records.englishName: Standing Reach Up Back Rotation Stretch
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise both arms overhead.
Gently arch your upper back and chest.
Rotate your torso to one side while maintaining the stretch.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
records.originalInstructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Reach both arms overhead and gently arch your upper back while rotating your torso to one side, focusing on stretching through your chest and shoulders. Hold for a moment, return to center, and repeat to the other side.
records.breathing: Inhale before reaching up; exhale as you rotate and stretch.

records.name: 屈臂站姿侧屈拉伸
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead, bending the elbow comfortably.
Lean sideways away from the raised arm to stretch the side of your torso.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, raise one arm overhead and bend it, then lean to the side while keeping the torso in one plane, hold the stretch, and repeat on the other side.
records.breathing: Breathe deeply throughout the stretch.

records.name: 站姿健腹轮前滚
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ab wheel.
Bend forward and place the wheel on the floor in front of your feet.
Roll the wheel forward, extending your arms and torso while keeping your core tight.
Lower your body until you're just above the floor, maintaining a straight line from head to heels.
Reverse the motion by pulling the wheel back toward your feet, returning to the start.
records.originalInstructions: Begin standing with an ab wheel on the floor in front of you. Holding the handles, slowly roll the wheel forward as you lower your torso, keeping your arms straight, until your body is almost parallel to the ground. Use your core and lats to pull yourself back up.
records.breathing: Inhale as you roll out, exhale as you pull back in.

records.name: 固定单车
steps: Set seat and handlebar to appropriate heights.
Sit upright and grip the handlebars lightly.
Place feet securely on the pedals.
Begin pedaling at a comfortable resistance and pace.
Continue for your intended duration, maintaining good form.
records.originalInstructions: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position for comfort and knee alignment. Pedal continuously at your desired intensity, maintaining good posture throughout the workout.
records.breathing: Breathe evenly and deeply throughout the session.

records.name: 直腿上举卷腹
steps: Lie on back, legs straight up, feet flexed.
Place arms beside you or hands behind head.
Engage core, lift head and shoulders toward legs.
Pause at top, exhale.
Lower down with control.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back with legs straight up in the air, arms at your sides or behind your head. Engage your core to lift your head, neck, and shoulders toward your feet, then lower back down with control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 仰卧哑铃弯举
steps: Lie flat on your back holding dumbbells at your sides, arms fully extended.
Keep palms facing forward (supinated grip).
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, elbows stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the weights slowly to the start position.
records.originalInstructions: Lie supine (face up) on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended. Keeping your upper arms still, curl the weights towards your shoulders, then lower under control.
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 跑步机跑步
steps: Step onto the treadmill and position feet on the sides.
Select preferred speed and incline.
Begin running, holding onto the handrails if necessary for balance.
Focus on smooth strides and upright posture.
Cool down by gradually reducing speed before stopping.
records.originalInstructions: Set your desired speed and incline on the treadmill. Start jogging or running, ensuring good posture with a natural stride. Adjust settings as needed for intensity and duration.
records.breathing: Inhale through nose, exhale through mouth in rhythm with strides.

records.name: 三头侧重双杠臂屈伸
steps: Sit on a bench or chair with hands gripping the edge.
Extend legs forward and slide hips off the seat.
Lower body by bending elbows to 90 degrees.
Press through palms to straighten arms and lift body.
Repeat for reps.
records.originalInstructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with hands next to your hips and legs extended forward. Slide your hips off the seat and lower your body by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees, then push yourself back up by straightening your arms.
formCues: Keep elbows close to your body
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower down, exhale as you push up.

records.name: 转体卷腹
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up, twisting your torso to bring one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Return to start and repeat to the other side.
Alternate sides for each repetition.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind head. Crunch up while rotating one elbow toward the opposite knee, then return and alternate sides.
records.breathing: Exhale as you crunch and twist, inhale as you return.

records.name: V字收腹
steps: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Engage your core to lift your legs and torso simultaneously.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top, forming a 'V' shape.
Pause briefly, squeezing your abs.
Lower down slowly to starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Simultaneously raise your legs and upper body, reaching your hands towards your feet to form a 'V' shape, then lower back down in control.
records.breathing: Exhale when lifting up, inhale as you lower down.

records.name: 双杠支撑举腿
aliases: straight leg raise on dip bars
hanging leg raise on parallel bars
steps: Support yourself on the parallel bars with straight arms and your legs hanging together.
Pull your shoulders down and brace your midsection to stop your body from swinging.
Keep your knees straight and lift your legs forward in front of you.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or slightly higher.
Pause briefly at the top without leaning back.
Lower your legs with control to the start and reset before the next repetition.
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso to start each rep
Bending the knees as the legs rise
Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears
Dropping the legs quickly on the way down
records.originalInstructions: Hang from the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight. Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight. Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you lift your legs, then inhale as you lower them back to the start.

records.name: 波浪步行机
steps: Step onto the machine and position feet on pedals.
Grip handles for stability.
Initiate movement by pushing one leg outward while the other follows.
Maintain a rhythmic, lateral gliding motion.
Continue for the desired time or intensity.
records.originalInstructions: Step onto the wave machine and grip the handles if available. Begin with a slow pace, moving feet in a side-to-side, skating motion. Gradually increase resistance and speed as you feel comfortable.
records.breathing: Keep breath steady and controlled throughout.

records.name: 负重伸腿卷腹
steps: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, holding a weight across your chest.
Lift your legs to tabletop position (knees over hips, 90-degree bend).
Simultaneously extend your legs outward and crunch your upper body up.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.
Return arms and legs to the starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Lie on your back holding a weight at your chest, legs lifted and knees bent. Extend your legs out as you crunch upward, then return to the start position.
records.breathing: Exhale as you crunch and extend, inhale as you return.

records.name: 负重仰卧转体
steps: Lie on your back with arms outstretched for support.
Hold a weight between your feet (or over chest).
Lift your legs up to a 90-degree angle.
Slowly rotate your legs to one side, keeping shoulders down.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
records.originalInstructions: Lie flat on your back, arms extended to your sides and holding a weight between your feet or over chest. Rotate your lower body side-to-side while stabilizing your upper body.
records.breathing: Exhale as you twist, inhale as you return to center.

records.name: 负重西斯深蹲
steps: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and hold the weight securely in front of your chest or across your upper back.
Rise onto the balls of your feet and brace your midsection.
Lean your torso back in one straight line from knees to shoulders as your knees travel forward.
Lower under control by bending your knees until you feel a strong stretch through the front of your thighs.
Drive through the balls of your feet and straighten your knees to return to the start.
Finish tall and reset your balance before the next repetition.
commonMistakes: Bending forward at the hips during the descent
Dropping the heels and shifting weight backward
Lowering too fast and bouncing out of the bottom
records.originalInstructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands, or place a barbell across your upper back. Keeping your chest up and your core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending at the knees and hips. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Inhale as you lower under control, then exhale as you drive back up to the starting position.

records.name: 负重站姿弯举
steps: Stand tall with a weight in each hand at your sides and turn your palms forward.
Set your feet about hip-width apart and keep your elbows pinned near your ribs.
Curl the weights upward by bending your elbows until your hands reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the weights back down with control until your arms are fully straightened at your sides.
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso to lift the weights
Letting the elbows drift forward at the top
Dropping the weights quickly on the way down
Bending the wrists back instead of keeping them neutral
records.originalInstructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward. Keep your elbows close to your torso and exhale as you curl the weights up to shoulder level. Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
records.breathing: Exhale as you curl the weights up, and inhale as you lower them back down under control.

records.name: 宽握绳索高位下拉
steps: Adjust the thigh pad and sit at the cable pulldown machine.
Grip the wide bar overhead with a pronated (overhand) grip, hands wider than shoulders.
Lean back slightly, brace your core, and retract your shoulder blades.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving elbows down and out.
Pause briefly, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
records.originalInstructions: Sit at the cable pulldown machine and grip the wide bar with hands wider than shoulder width and palms facing forward. Engage your core, pull your shoulder blades down and back, and pull the bar down to your upper chest while keeping your back straight. Slowly return the bar to the starting position while controlling the resistance.
records.breathing: Exhale as you pull the bar down, inhale as you return to start.

records.name: 手腕绕环
steps: Extend arms out in front or to sides.
Make fists or keep hands open.
Slowly rotate wrists in circular motions.
Perform several circles in one direction.
Switch direction and repeat.
records.originalInstructions: Extend your arms in front or to your sides. Make fists or keep hands open, then slowly rotate wrists in circular motions, both clockwise and counterclockwise.
records.breathing: Breathe evenly throughout the movement.
